verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents Global Accounts that receive bank transfers via local rails and SWIFT into the Wallet, and lets you programmatically create accounts with local bank details in 60+ markets. This loosely supports holding multiple receiving accounts. Nothing in the evidence shows dedicated checking sub-accounts or any rule that automatically splits incoming deposits across them. Missing for 10: explicit sub-account or multiple-wallet structure for one business, automatic allocation or sweep rules for incoming deposits, independent or hands-on corroboration.
